bio: Postdoctoral Research Fellow Epidemiology, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Epidemiology Henrik von Kleist is a postdoctoral research fellow at CAUSALab in the Department of Epidemiology at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. His research focuses on Active Feature Acquisition - AI systems that recommend which clinical tests to order to improve medical diagnosis or treatment. His work integrates causal inference, reinforcement learning, and semiparametric theory to enable reliable and efficient evaluation and optimization of such systems using observational clinical data. He completed his PhD at Helmholtz Munich and the Technical University of Munich. Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Methods for Time-varying Feature Settings Henrik von Kleist, Alireza Zamanian, Ilya Shpitser, Narges Ahmidi. Journal of Machine Learning Research 2026
